typical_symptoms: shot-hole formation where dead centers drop out
visual_characteristics: numerous small circular to irregular brown spots across the leaf blade
perforations ('shot-holes') where necrotic tissue has fallen out of the leaf
darkening or blackening of major veins
scattered lighter-colored halos or centers within lesions
lesion_characteristics: defined dark borders with necrotic or missing centers
size ranging from 1 to 5 mm in diameter
color_characteristics: light brown to dark brown spots
dark brown to nearly black discolored veins
texture_characteristics: perforated texture due to tissue drop-out
spatial_patterns: scattered spots across the leaf surface
distinguishing_features: prominent shot-hole effect combined with dark vein necrosis
widespread small perforations across the entire lamina
